mathematical_formulation.flawed_sigmoid_equation: delta = sigmoid(alpha) * LayerNorm(W * v40 + b) = (1 / (1 + exp(-alpha))) * LayerNorm(W * v40 + b)

representation_physics_analysis.linear_gate_behavior: With alpha approx -0.0066, direct linear multiplication scales the injection to approx 0.66% of the token embedding norm. This functions strictly as a subtle residual attention nudge, preserving the base language model representations while steering multi-head attention toward the temporal anchor.
representation_physics_analysis.sigmoid_gate_behavior: Evaluating with sigmoid(alpha) forced a positive scale factor of approx 0.498, inflating the injection amplitude by approx 76x and reversing its direction. A 50% magnitude perturbation overwhelmed the token embedding vector, corrupting semantic processing and producing artificially degraded legacy accuracy metrics.

verdict.summary: Restoring linear gate mode re-establishes exact parity with the training forward pass, eliminating a 76x amplitude explosion and sign reversal.
